procedural: It is time to set up full automation of TNF marketing using TNF agentic processes.

We need to make sure that the SAAS side of TNF at thenewfuse.com is fully complete with all those tools that will make setting up agentic processes and online work faithfully executed to run both from the cloud and fully integrated with the locally installed companion version (open source).

The wensite also needs to stay automatically updated with fresh AI and related tech news daily(retrieved and set up by AI Agents) It is time to attract a community of contributors to the open source version, and automate the review and PR merging processes.
The website must be tested by AI Agents daily by them exploring every feature and functionality as a human or online Agent would.
